dedupe_keys.name: orsep registro de presas fiscalizadas register of dams supervised by argentina s dam safety regulator with a page per dam grouped by region norte cuyo centro comahue patagonia

description: The register of supervised dams is the public list of dams overseen by ORSEP, Argentina's dam safety regulator within the Ministry of Economy's public works area. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists the dams by regional office, Norte, Cuyo, Centro, Comahue and Patagonia, each name linking to its own page; the part read names 31 structures, from Escaba, Río Hondo and Los Quiroga in the north through Agua del Toro, Los Reyunos and El Nihuil in Cuyo to the large hydropower dams of the Comahue region, such as El Chocón, Alicurá, Piedra del Águila and Pichi Picún Leufú, and Futaleufú and Florentino Ameghino in Patagonia. The individual dam pages, whose contents such as dam type, height, purpose or safety status were not read, carry the details. Coverage is the dams under national supervision in Argentina, not every dam in the country. Access is free on the government portal; no licence is stated. Caveats: the Centro section may hold further dams not captured in the text read, and the list is not offered as a downloadable table. It supports hazard exposure and resilience studies, such as identifying the large hydropower dams upstream of cities in the Comahue valley for dam break scenarios. Related record: the Global Dam Storage dataset.
